Evidence not re-executed here: the suite matrix (task 21.12), the live pinned-host matrix (task 21.13), and the security review (task 21.14) were read and reconciled, not re-run; the artifact was hashed, not rebuilt; the manifest was regenerated and compared but not modified. This task changed no code, test, build metadata, manifest, or artifact, so per the validation-rerun rule no suite/live re-run was required. Any subsequent change to the sources or build inputs invalidates the recorded identity and those results.

Optional non-blocking release-note choice left open for the orchestrator/user (SEC-21.10-02): the manifest.json/build.yaml 1.2.0.0 changelog one-liner does not state that a provider 3xx is no longer followed. Precondition: the tree's build.yaml is a packaged archive entry, so adding the clause changes artifacts/ArrTags_1.2.0.0.zip (and therefore the manifest checksum/identity) and would require re-running the task 21.12 clean-build identity derivation and invalidating the task 21.13 live matrix and task 21.14 security review verified against the current bytes. Consequence: the release notes omit that one behavior change; the change itself is fully recorded in docs/changelog/v1.2.0.md, docs/architecture/07 and 11, and the ADR-005 implementation note, and no security or verification claim depends on the release-note wording.

artifacts/ArrTags_1.2.0.0.zip is gitignored build output and is not part of the committed tree; the committed manifest.json checksum refers to that locally produced corrected artifact, and no automated test guards archive byte-identity (pre-existing limitation).

The changelog release section cites the task 21.13/21.14 records as the live and security evidence; the pinned musl host cannot present a Windows-style, UNC, mixed-separator, or non-printing-scalar-bearing media path, so SEC-21.5-02/SEC-21.5-03 rest on the repository's LogSubjectTests and the task 21.14 reproduction rather than the live matrix (stated in the section and in the final readiness record).

docs/implementation/21.6/release-readiness.json is immutable history and still records the superseded task 21.8 artifact identity; the new final record supersedes it for the gate and the changelog states the superseded status.
